title: ProfileVocabulary
description: The semantic vocabulary an implementation uses to build and compare DerivedEntity and DerivedRelation objects: entity types, predicates, predicate families, and qualifier dimensions. This is ORTHOGONAL to temporal authority: a TemporalGroundingProfile answers evidenceUnit -> sourceState -> admissible(t) and says nothing about what a predicate means, while a ProfileVocabulary fixes meaning and identity and says nothing about time. The effective profile of an implementation is the pair ⟨vocabulary, groundingProfile⟩; the same vocabulary MAY be grounded on different substrates, and the same grounding profile MAY serve different vocabularies. The core declares NO universal taxonomy for any of these lists: it requires only that the values an implementation emits be declared here, with their semantics, and be discoverable through the introspection operations. Identity comparison is scoped to a vocabulary version; temporal state is scoped to a grounding-profile version.

id.description: Opaque, unique identifier for this vocabulary.

version.description: Explicit vocabulary version (semantic versioning recommended). Automatic identity comparison is scoped to a fixed vocabulary version.

label.description: Optional display name. Never an identity.

semantics.description: What this predicate asserts of source and target.

family.description: Optional family this predicate belongs to; MUST be declared in `predicateFamilies`.

label.description: Optional display name. Never an identity.

predicateFamilies.description: Coarse predicate families admitted in `DerivedRelation.predicateFamily`. An implementation MUST NOT emit a family absent from this list.

semantics.description: What this family classifies, precisely enough that an auditor can decide whether a given predicate belongs to it.

label.description: Optional display name. Never an identity.

qualifierDimensions.description: Qualifier dimensions admitted in `DerivedRelation.qualifiers`, and which of them are identity-relevant.

dimension.description: The dimension name, matching the key in `DerivedRelation.qualifiers`.

semantics.description: What this dimension qualifies and what its values range over.

identityRelevant.description: Whether this dimension participates in the relation identity key. Changing it changes identity, so it is a vocabulary-version change.

label.description: Optional display name. Never an identity.

description.description: Optional prose description of the vocabulary and the domain it carves.
